children: Edible Garden regained compliance with Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid price requirement.
Nasdaq confirmed Edible Garden meets Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) after the July 27, 2026 Panel decision.
Company will be under a Mandatory Panel Monitor through Aug 31, 2027 with heightened delisting risk if noncompliant.
Failure to stay compliant during monitoring bars additional cure periods and could prompt immediate delisting action.
Nasdaq Hearing Panel retains jurisdiction through Nov 23, 2026 and may delist immediately if bid price lapses.
Company issued a press release announcing compliance; press release filed as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K.
